notes: Lowered the SCM speaker amp's auto-idle peak threshold (AMP_IDLE_PEAK_THRESHOLD) from 0.003 to 0.0005 -- Ed reported the amp cutting out during quiet passages of playing audio, which meant the previous threshold was catching genuine low-level signal as 'silence' and shutting the NS4150B off mid-passage. Lower threshold only counts truly-silent output as idle, so quiet audio stays classified as active and the amp stays on.
